body.statement:
For every closed convex cone \(C\subset\mathbb R^d\), its statistical dimension satisfies
\[
 \delta(C)=\mathbb E\|\Pi_C(G)\|_2^2,
 \qquad G\sim\mathcal N(0,I_d),
\]
where \(\Pi_C\) is Euclidean projection onto \(C\).

source.verbatim_statement: The statistical dimension delta(C) of a closed convex cone C satisfies delta(C)=E ||Pi_C(g)||^2, where g is a standard normal vector.

attestation.note: Directly checked Proposition 2.4 in the primary arXiv:1303.6672v2 PDF.
